articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: NEAR Protocol (NEAR) gains 6.3%, leading index higher
articles.snippet: Internet Computer (ICP), up 5.8% from Thursday, was also a top performer.

articles.title: Coinbase bulls point to crypto legislation and stablecoins after earnings miss
articles.snippet: Analysts say Coinbase’s long-term growth may depend more on stablecoins and U.S. crypto legislation than a rebound in trading activity.

articles.title: CLARITY Act will help reshore US crypto industry, attorney says
articles.snippet: The "biggest market" in crypto is conducting the vast majority of its trading volume outside of US-based exchanges, according to Attorney Bill Hughes.

articles.title: Crypto exchanges pushed US lawmakers to bar provision on risky tokens: Report
articles.snippet: Three companies reportedly pressed US senators for changes to a crypto bill, removing language that would require them to offer trading on tokens “not readily susceptible to manipulation.”

articles.title: Crypto Firms Race to 'Quantum-Proof' Wallets Before Bitcoin, Ethereum Networks Catch Up
articles.snippet: Crypto companies are upgrading wallets to counter the coming quantum computing threat, but gaps remain.
